description: ED alleged that Sayid Muhammad arranged mule bank accounts; Kerala High Court judgment records related prosecution allegations.
ED identified Varghese T G as a key accused in the mule-account network.
ED identified Daniel Selvakumar as director of Xoduz Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
ED described Daniel Selvakumar in connection with Tyrannus Technology Pvt. Ltd.
ED identified Allen Samuel as director of Aprikiwi Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
ED identified Anto Paul Prakash as proprietor of Global Expositions and Infomedia Solutions.
ED identified Anto Paul Prakash as director of Sozo Technology Pvt. Ltd.
ED identified Kathiravan Ravi as director of Future Vision Media Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Kerala High Court judgment records prosecution material alleging an approach to Nitin Varghese for opening bank accounts.
Court-recorded prosecution material alleges that account details reached Sayid through Leema.
Court-recorded prosecution material names Angel in connection with allegedly supplied mule-account information.
ED and court-recorded prosecution material describe crypto accounts and WazirX-linked activity.
ED stated that 26 cryptocurrency accounts on WazirX were linked to mule bank accounts.
ED stated that WazirX-linked crypto accounts facilitated cross-border crypto remittances to foreign wallets.
The destination was described as foreign wallets; Singapore is separately reported as a destination for banking-channel remittances. Do not equate all foreign wallets with Singapore.
Mule accounts were described as receiving proceeds connected to victims of the fake loan-app scam.
Public sources describe fake loan apps/APKs being used to obtain loans and victim data, followed by alleged extortion.
Court-recorded prosecution material describes social-media circulation/advertising of loan-app APKs.
Court-recorded prosecution material describes advertising/contact through WhatsApp.
ED described a remittance channel involving Nium India. Store the channel relationship without implying Nium itself is a criminal actor.
ED/prosecution material described banking-channel transfers to Singapore via companies/shell entities.
Media reporting names Xoduz Solutions among entities searched/investigated in connection with the cluster.
Vicky Venkat Technology is named in media reporting as an entity in the money-flow/company layer.
Vikrah Trading Enterprise is named in media reporting as an entity in the money-flow/company layer.
Media reports link Raphael James Rozario with mule-bank-account arrangements; preserve as reported allegation.
Media report names Afreed K Y in relation to mule-account arrangements; preserve as source-reported.
ED alleged Sayid received remuneration for arranging mule accounts; court-recorded prosecution material gives additional details.
ED alleged Varghese received remuneration for arranging mule/crypto accounts.
Court-recorded prosecution material describes Sayid receiving information through an online contact named Leema.
Court-recorded prosecution material names Angel as another alleged contact in the account-supply chain.
